body:
Generated sixteen independent light UI concepts: desktop and mobile versions
of Focus, Project, Board, Calendar, Timeline, List, Updates and Card details,
as explicitly requested. The set includes separate PNGs, full prompts, a local
gallery and ZIP under test-results/ui-design-2026-09-25/screens/.

All screens were visually reviewed. These are illustrative design proposals;
generated-detail limitations are documented alongside them. No application
implementation, scope, priority, card status or acceptance changed.
Evidence: progress/2026-09-25-individual-ui-concepts.md.

metadata.summary: Prepared sixteen separate desktop and mobile UI concepts
